verdict.rationale: Supabase's llms.txt publishes per-language reference corpora for agents (JS, Dart, Swift, Kotlin, Python, C#), which points to official multi-language SDKs. Storage image transformations cite client-library support, and type generation produces a type-safe `database.types.ts` to build against. missing for 10: direct first-party SDK documentation pages in the pack (install/usage of e.g. supabase-js), explicit statement of which SDKs are officially maintained versus community, and hands-on or independent corroboration of SDK usage.
